_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2: vennootschapsbelasting (Vpb) corporate-tax administration for Dutch government enterprises. Adds two operator-authored schemas (TaxDeadline tracking Vpb filing/payment deadlines; TaxPaymentTracking recording provisional/final/adjustment payments linked to a GL account) plus one read-only computed schema (QuarterlyTaxStatement) whose x-openregister-aggregations block documents the per-fiscal-period revenue/expenses/net-taxable-income roll-up that OCA\Shillinq\Service\TaxReportService materialises on demand from existing GLTransaction + GLLine data via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll). The fragment ALSO additively extends the monolith GLLine schema with a taxTreatment classification property (normal/deductible/nonDeductible/special) through the loader's additive key-union merge (SettingsService:deepMergeConfig). The monolith is never edited. Seed objects provide three representative FY-2025 deadlines and two sample payments per design.md.

taxTreatment.description: Vpb tax-treatment classification of this posting. Additively merged onto the monolith GLLine schema via the ADR-037 fragment loader. normal = ordinary deductible business expense/revenue; deductible = tax-benefit item (R&D, green investment); nonDeductible = disallowed (gifts, entertainment, personal use); special = subject to special rules (dividend received, transfer-pricing). Defaults to normal when omitted.
taxTreatment.title: Tax Treatment

TaxDeadline.title: Tax Deadline
TaxDeadline.description: A vennootschapsbelasting (Vpb) filing or payment deadline for one administration. Tracks the deadline date, type (provisional payment, final return, extension request), the fiscal year/quarter it covers, and a lifecycle status (pending → submitted → filed → archived). Operator-authored; CRUD is served by OpenRegister's generic object API.

deadlineDate.description: Calendar date the deadline falls due.
deadlineDate.title: Deadline Date

description.example: First provisional Vpb payment for FY 2025
description.title: Description

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the deadline relates to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

quarter.description: Quarter (1-4) for quarterly deadlines; null for annual deadlines.
quarter.title: Quarter

relatedPeriodId.description: FK to the fiscal period this deadline covers (string identifier for T1 compatibility).
relatedPeriodId.title: Related Period ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this deadline belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Tax Deadline is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

TaxPaymentTracking.title: Tax Payment Tracking
TaxPaymentTracking.description: A recorded Vpb payment (provisional, final, or adjustment) linked to a GL account by accountNumber. Reconciliation matches the record to GL postings by account + amount + date (design.md D2); GL is authoritative and these records index payments for deadline tracking. Operator-authored; CRUD via OpenRegister's generic object API.

amount.description: Payment amount in the stated currency.
amount.title: Amount

linkedGLAccount.description: FK to Account.accountNumber the payment is posted against.
linkedGLAccount.title: Linked GL Account

relatedDeadlineId.description: FK to the TaxDeadline this payment satisfies (slug or id).
relatedDeadlineId.title: Related Deadline ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this payment belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Tax Payment Tracking is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

QuarterlyTaxStatement.title: Quarterly Tax Statement
QuarterlyTaxStatement.description: Read-only computed Vpb quarterly income statement. Materialised on demand by OCA\Shillinq\Service\TaxReportService from GLTransaction + GLLine via the real OpenRegister ObjectService API (find/findAll): never authored by operators. The x-openregister-aggregations block documents the equivalent declarative roll-up: GLLine filtered by administration + fiscal period, grouped by account type and taxTreatment, producing revenue, operating expenses, non-operating items, special deductions and net taxable income, plus an untagged-posting warning count.

administrationId.description: Administration the statement is scoped to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

periodId.description: Fiscal period identifier the statement covers.
periodId.title: Period ID

nonOperating.description: Non-deductible items (taxTreatment nonDeductible), added back to taxable income.
nonOperating.title: Non Operating

netTaxableIncome.description: Computed net taxable income = revenue - operatingExpenses + nonOperating - specialDeductions.
netTaxableIncome.title: Net Taxable Income

untaggedCount.description: Count of tax-relevant GL postings lacking a taxTreatment tag.
untaggedCount.title: Untagged Count

quarterlyTaxStatement.description: Declarative shape of the quarterly Vpb statement TaxReportService computes. Filters GLLine by administrationId + periodId, joins Account for accountType, groups by accountType and taxTreatment, sums amounts, and derives netTaxableIncome = revenue - operatingExpenses + nonOperating - specialDeductions. When the aggregation engine cannot express the GLLine→Account join + tax-treatment grouping, TaxReportService computes the same result in PHP via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Quarterly Tax Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
